insights.title: Purchase type by app — Subscription revenue is growing most in YMK (+17.5%).
insights.body: By app: the biggest Subscription gain is YMK +43,113 (+17.5%); Pay as you go moved most in YCP -1,540 (-13.7%); YCV relies most on Pay as you go (13% of its revenue vs 6.0% overall). Subscription is the recurring revenue that new subs feed; Pay as you go is one-off spend.

insights.title: Which app — App Total Revenue +13.3% is mostly YMK — not every app.
insights.body: App Total Revenue moved +13.3% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App +13.3%, YMK +16.7%, YCP +7.5%, YCV +12.1%). YMK accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.
